Reinstall or channel switch (APK ↔ Google Play)
Google Play and APK use different signatures — the app cannot be updated over itself. A copy preserves the data.
1. Make a copy: “Save a copy now” or “Export with password”. Remember the password.
2. Uninstall the app. In-app data will be deleted — that is expected.
3. Install the APK or the Google Play version again and restore the copy from the folder or from a file.
Without a copy the data cannot be returned: Android cloud backup is disabled on purpose.

A JSON file is not password-protected: anyone who gets it can read your mood, medications, and journal. Keep it separately and delete it after the transfer.

The server is completely optional: Anchor works without it. Only an https:// address is supported — Android blocks unencrypted HTTP.
